description: Soft operating targets, not hard provider output limits or paid quotas. Token counts for memory context are approximate.

gateway.rule: Route by trusted Discord channel ID using deterministic commands. No research context or raw logs.

supervisor.rule: Decompose work, use compact checkpoints and source pointers, not full transcripts.

implementer.rule: Read source code locally. Ask for specific memory rather than dumping the project history.

reviewer.rule: Review commit SHA/diff, test artifacts and acceptance criteria; never re-read implementation chat.

explorer.rule: Bound exploration to an explicit question, deliver links and findings, not open-ended search.

execution.discord_log_policy: Summary and evidence pointer only. Never paste raw terminal or secrets.
execution.thread_expiration_policy: Archive completed threads after operator review; memory retained by project, not by Discord history.
